raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`bench_one_batch_server` skips a `(batch_size, input_len, output_len)` point when its resident tokens would not fit the server's KV pool, so a sweep does not spend a timeout on a batch the scheduler can never admit at once. With `--input-len-list` (per-request ragged input lengths) that check sums the per-request lengths, which is the right total for a single attention group.

With attention data parallelism the total is not enough. The DP controller round-robins requests over the DP ranks, so request `i` lands on rank `i % num_dp_ranks`, and a ragged list that cycles with the rank count puts every long request on the same rank. The batch can fit the pool in aggregate while that rank's share overflows, and the surplus requests queue behind the batch instead of running with it: the point is then measured as a smaller batch plus a second wave, which is not the shape the sweep asked for.

## Modifications

- `should_skip_due_to_token_capacity` takes `num_dp_ranks` (default 1). For a ragged batch on more than one rank it also computes the heaviest rank's resident tokens under round-robin placement and skips when that rank's share, scaled to the whole pool, exceeds the threshold. Uniform batches and single-rank servers are unchanged.
- `run_benchmark_internal` passes the server's `num_dp_ranks` (already read from `/server_info`) to the check; the vLLM path sets it to 1.
- `test/registered/unit/bench/test_one_batch_ragged_capacity.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`) pins the uniform total, the ragged total, the heaviest-rank bound with a two-rank round-robin example, and that uniform batches ignore `num_dp_ranks`.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only decides whether a sweep point is skipped before any request is sent.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Not applicable; no serving code path changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation).
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed, according to [Benchmark and Profiling](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.html) and [Accuracy Results](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#accuracy-results).

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+"""Unit tests for the one-batch KV-capacity skip with ragged --input-len-list batches."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.benchmark.one_batch_server import should_skip_due_to_token_capacity
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestRaggedTokenCapacity(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_uniform_batch_counts_the_total(self):
+        self.assertFalse(should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 100, 10, 440))
+        self.assertTrue(should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 100, 10, 439))
+
+    def test_ragged_batch_sums_its_lengths(self):
+        self.assertFalse(should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 0, 10, 440, "50,150"))
+        self.assertTrue(should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 0, 10, 439, "50,150"))
+
+    def test_heaviest_dp_rank_must_fit_its_share(self):
+        # Round-robin over 2 ranks: rank 0 holds 300 + 300, rank 1 holds 100 + 100.
+        lens = "300,100"
+        self.assertFalse(should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 0, 0, 800, lens))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 0, 0, 800, lens, num_dp_ranks=2)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(4, 0, 0, 1200, lens, num_dp_ranks=2)
+        )
+
+    def test_uniform_batch_ignores_dp_ranks(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            should_skip_due_to_token_capacity(3, 100, 0, 300, num_dp_ranks=2)
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
